volume_shapes.name: Twin Vector-Thrust Engines (V-TEN)
volume_shapes.description: Twin 12-segment cylindrical nacelles with intake cowlings, cooling compression ribs, flared titanium exhaust bells, and recessed plasma flame throats.

volume_shapes.name: Command Module & Tranquility Canopy
volume_shapes.callout: Cockpit and Command Module (Reinforced Tranquility Canopy)
volume_shapes.description: Pressurized 3D teardrop capsule dome with high curved canopy crest, armored chine rails, polarized sapphire-quartz viewport facets, and 3-crew flight deck.

volume_shapes.name: Lifting-Body Hull & Chine Polyhedron
volume_shapes.callout: Internal Superconducting Power Conduit Matrix & Main Hull
volume_shapes.description: Chiseled aerodynamic wedge core distributing aerodynamic lifting loads, housing the superconducting energy grid and deuterium fuel reservoirs.

volume_shapes.name: Central Aether-Reactor Spine
volume_shapes.callout: 'ARROW' Identity Etching Matrix & Reactor Containment Cowl
volume_shapes.description: Raised prismatic dorsal spine protecting the central reactor matrix with thermal dissipation vents and axial 'A R R O W' identity alignment.

volume_shapes.name: 3-Tier Crenellated Phalanx Wings
volume_shapes.callout: Faceted Armor Wings (Aegis Alloy Construction) & Wingtip Fins
volume_shapes.description: Swept delta wings with 3-tier stepped serrated battlements, providing aerodynamic supersonic lift, kinetic shield projection, and canted wingtip stabilizers.

volume_shapes.name: Outrigger Truss Booms & Turrets
volume_shapes.callout: Automated Defense Turrets & Beam Cannon Ports
volume_shapes.description: Swept structural outrigger booms bridging the cockpit neck to the wing shoulders, featuring open negative-space voids and mounting 6 heavy blaster cannon barrels.

volume_shapes.name: Sensor Prow & Targeting Needle
volume_shapes.callout: Long-Range Targeting & Forward Optical Sensor Array
volume_shapes.description: Forward-projecting needle cone with diamond radome base, housing deep-space long-range targeting sensors, hyperspace transceivers, and optical arrays.

volume_shapes.name: FTL Drive Cluster & Stinger Stern
volume_shapes.callout: Aft Point (Rear Aegis Shield Emitter & Refueling Port)
volume_shapes.description: Tapered rhomboid stern block with cooling louvers, secondary FTL field emitters, fuel intake port, and aft defense stinger needle.

volume_shapes.name: Ventral Keel Blade & Comm Dish
volume_shapes.description: Ventral stabilizing keel blade and recessed phased-array communications dish providing multi-sector data uplink.
